title: Phone CLIs survive a missing kuhy-credit
objective: phone_deploy.sh calls python3 -m python_pkg.phone_lease with whatever python3 is on PATH. A missing kuhy-credit package must not crash the lease or the android_ui driver; the credit stays in --help whenever the package is present.
acceptance_criteria: python -m python_pkg.phone_lease --help and python -m python_pkg.android_ui --help exit 0 with kuhy_credit blocked.
test_cli_credit.py still finds the credit line in both --help outputs when kuhy_credit is installed.
out_of_scope: The other ten credited CLIs, which are not started by phone tooling.
